title: Compatibility of a reflected composition isomorphism with completion units
statement:
Let $\mathcal A_0,\mathcal A_1,\mathcal A_2$ be categories with full subcategories $\mathcal C_i$ and reflectors $C_i$ with units $\kappa_i$: for $N\in\mathcal C_i$, precomposition induces $\operatorname{Hom}(C_iM,N)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(M,N)$. Identify the reflectors with endofunctors through the full inclusions. Let $L_{01}\dashv R_{10}$, $L_{12}\dashv R_{21}$ and $L_{02}\dashv R_{20}$ be adjunctions between the corresponding ambient categories, where $L_{ij}:\mathcal A_i\to\mathcal A_j$ and each $R_{ji}$ carries $\mathcal C_j$ into $\mathcal C_i$. Fix $d:R_{20}\xrightarrow{\sim}R_{10}R_{21}$ and let $c:L_{12}L_{01}\xrightarrow{\sim}L_{02}$ be its adjunction conjugate, using the composite adjunction [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction], [lem-weil-pbc-conjugate-iso-unit-equation]. Put $P_{ij}=C_jL_{ij}|_{\mathcal C_i}$ with the adjunction to restricted $R_{ji}$ induced by the reflector and ordinary Hom bijections. For $M\in\mathcal C_i$, write $k_{ij,M}=\kappa_{j,L_{ij}M}:L_{ij}M\to P_{ij}M$.
The conjugate of $d|_{\mathcal C_2}$ is a natural isomorphism $c^c:P_{12}P_{01}\xrightarrow{\sim}P_{02}$, and for every $M\in\mathcal C_0$ it satisfies the identity
$$c^c_M\,k_{12,P_{01}M}\,L_{12}(k_{01,M})=k_{02,M}\,c_M.$$
Equivalently the right side is the ordinary composite-adjunction transpose of $d_{P_{02}M}$ composed with the unit for $P_{02}\dashv R_{20}$. This equality compares the specified reflected conjugate with the specified ambient conjugate and all three noninvertible completion units; it is natural in $M$.

proof.text:
Write $\eta_{ij}$ for the ambient adjunction units and $\Phi_{ij}$ for their Hom bijections, so $\Phi_{ij}(a)=R_{ji}(a)\eta_{ij,M}$. All compositions below are read right to left. By the specified reflected Hom bijection, for $M\in\mathcal C_i$, $N\in\mathcal C_j$ and $t:P_{ij}M\to N$, its adjunct is
$$\Phi^c_{ij}(t)=\Phi_{ij}(t k_{ij,M}).$$
This is a natural bijection: its first factor is precomposition with the natural reflector unit and its second is the given adjunction bijection; fullness identifies the ambient Hom sets with those in the subcategories. The right-adjoint preservation assumption ensures $R_{ji}N\in\mathcal C_i$. In particular the reflected unit is $\eta^c_{ij,M}=R_{ji}(k_{ij,M})\eta_{ij,M}$, by applying this formula to $t=1_{P_{ij}M}$. These are computations with the Hom bijections specified in the hypothesis, and require no additivity or invertibility of $k_{ij,M}$.

proof.text:
The natural isomorphism $d$ restricts to $D_{20}\xrightarrow{\sim}D_{10}D_{21}$ on the full subcategories, where $D_{ji}=R_{ji}|$: preservation puts both endpoints there, and fullness includes both $d_N$ and its inverse. Use [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction] for $P_{12}P_{01}\dashv D_{10}D_{21}$ and apply [lem-weil-pbc-conjugate-iso-unit-equation] with $L_1=P_{12}P_{01}$, $L_2=P_{02}$ and $\delta=d|$. It gives the specified natural isomorphism $c^c$, characterized by
$$\Phi^c_{01}(\Phi^c_{12}(c^c_M))=d_{P_{02}M}\eta^c_{02,M}.$$
Here the left side is precisely the composite-adjunction transpose, since the composite Hom bijection is the successive pair of Hom bijections in [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction].

proof.text:
Fix $M\in\mathcal C_0$ and $N\in\mathcal C_2$, and put $s_M=k_{12,P_{01}M}L_{12}(k_{01,M})$. For any $t:P_{12}P_{01}M\to N$, set $u=t k_{12,P_{01}M}$. Naturality of the ambient unit $\eta_{12}$ at $k_{01,M}:L_{01}M\to P_{01}M$ gives the three-line calculation
$$\begin{aligned}
\Phi_{12}(t s_M)&=R_{21}(u)R_{21}L_{12}(k_{01,M})\eta_{12,L_{01}M}\\
&=R_{21}(u)\eta_{12,P_{01}M}k_{01,M}\\
&=\Phi^c_{12}(t)k_{01,M}.
\end{aligned}$$
Apply $\Phi_{01}$ and use step 1 once more. Since $R_{21}N\in\mathcal C_1$, that step applies to the map $\Phi^c_{12}(t):P_{01}M\to R_{21}N$. Thus
$$\Phi_{01}(\Phi_{12}(t s_M))=\Phi^c_{01}(\Phi^c_{12}(t)).$$
Both sides are now the specified composite transposes, by [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction]. This computation only reassociates maps and uses unit naturality; it never cancels a completion unit.

proof.text:
For completeness check naturality of this equation explicitly. If $a:M\to M'$ in $\mathcal C_0$, naturality of the two reflector units gives
$$P_{12}P_{01}(a)s_M
=k_{12,P_{01}M'}L_{12}(P_{01}(a))L_{12}(k_{01,M})
=s_{M'}L_{12}L_{01}(a).$$
Naturality of $c^c$ then gives
$$P_{02}(a)c^c_Ms_M=c^c_{M'}s_{M'}L_{12}L_{01}(a).$$
For the other side, naturality of $k_{02}$ and $c$ gives
$$P_{02}(a)k_{02,M}c_M
=k_{02,M'}L_{02}(a)c_M
=k_{02,M'}c_{M'}L_{12}L_{01}(a).$$
Thus the displayed equality is an equality of natural transformations from the restricted ambient functor $L_{12}L_{01}|_{\mathcal C_0}$ to $P_{02}$.
